title: VideoMM: Adaptive Macro-Micro Inference for Efficient Video MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.16722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to long-form video understanding is bottlenecked by the explosion of visual tokens, which saturates context windows and incurs prohibitive costs. Current solutions predominantly rely on auxiliary models for token reduction but face a fundamental dilemma: lightweight encoder-driven approaches often overlook critical semantic information, whereas heavyweight MLLM-driven reduction negates the efficiency gains. {In this work, we identify a more fundamental inefficiency underlying this dilemma: while fine-grained visual details are essential for detailed understanding, they are largely redundant for the preliminary task of selecting semantically relevant regions. } Motivated by this, we introduce \textbf{VideoMM}, which marks a paradigm shift from model-centric downsizing to adaptive perceptual granularity. translated_title: VideoMM：面向高效视频多模态大语言模型的自适应宏-微推理
translated_abstract: 将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）扩展至长视频理解受到视觉token数量爆炸式增长的制约，这会耗尽上下文窗口并带来高昂的成本。当前的解决方案主要依赖辅助模型进行token削减，但面临一个根本性困境：轻量级的编码器驱动方法往往忽略关键的语义信息，而重量级的MLLM驱动削减则抵消了效率收益。在这项工作中，我们识别出这一困境背后更根本的低效问题：虽然细粒度的视觉细节对于精细理解至关重要，但对于选择语义相关区域这一初步任务而言，它们在很大程度上是冗余的。受此启发，我们提出了VideoMM，标志着从以模型为中心的缩减向自适应感知粒度的范式转变。具体而言，我们的框架通过执行语义过滤，将选择过程与推理过程解耦……
tldr: VideoMM提出“宏-微”自适应推理范式，将语义区域选择与精细推理解耦——用轻量粗粒度感知完成token筛选、再以细粒度细节进行推理，从而高效解决长视频理解中的视觉token爆炸问题。
en_tdlr: VideoMM introduces an adaptive macro-micro inference paradigm that decouples semantic region selection from detailed reasoning, enabling efficient long-form video understanding by eliminating redundant fine-grained visual tokens without sacrificing semantic information.
